g.text: Poles and zeros link a transfer function to time and frequency behavior

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Stable causal rational example with real left-half-plane poles and zero. Unit-step response starts at0, overshoots, and tends to H(0)=1/3. The pole-zero
plot and response share the same transfer function; input is a unit step and initial conditions are zero.
